notes.title: BossAss V1.1.3 is out now! Attach an update description.
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear Players:[/h2]

This update focuses on fixing issues and does not add any new features.
We're preparing a[b] little surprise[/b] for everyone, and when it's ready, it's going to be presented to you!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090244/705c6f09cbb7f0f7ce3f729450928b1892e72558.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38090244/3e2b09f9434152d23cdaf95ae32bc0fa17878544.png[/img][/url]

[h2]The following is the content of this update:[/h2]

[h3]BUG Fix[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixes an issue that caused the plot text to appear incomplete;
[*] Fixes an issue where the player immediately becomes stuck when the game is cleared when he ticks Skip The Opening Story;
[*] Fixes some of the previously discovered abnormal text displays;
[/olist]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Minor adjustments have been made to the effect of the plot text display;
[/olist]


TOWA Software
October 5, 2020.
